name: Henry II of Iron
note: ruled jointly with his brother Nicholas; with Schleswig 1375-1386

name: Nicholas I
note: co-ruler with Henry II, later with nephews Gerhard VI and Albert II (from 1384)

name: Gerhard VI
note: co-ruler in Rendsburg with uncle Nicholas since 1384; in Schleswig since 1386

name: Albert II
note: co-ruler; source lists his part as County of Segeberg

name: Elisabeth
note: daughter of Nicholas I; County of Rendsburg (at Åbenrå); co-ruler

name: Henry III
note: born c. 1372; also Prince-Bishop of Osnabrück

name: Adolph XI
note: ruled jointly with brother Gerhard VII; with Schleswig; then Rendsburg and Schleswig annexed to Denmark, the Danish forming the Duchy of Holstein with the Rendsburg patrimony

name: Christian I
note: King of Denmark; chosen heir to the County of Holstein-Rendsburg, ascended 1460; elevated in 1474 from Count of Holstein-Rendsburg to Duke of Holstein (new title; list stops)
